texts.zh:
[Species.GetAdj]民众正在逐渐接受一个可以用强化体以全新的方式表达自我的世界。

但这种宽容只是表象，植入体的内增强监控算法现在正在监视着每一个人，在大脑突触连接的那一刻就能发现不当的想法。
texts.en:
The [Species.GetAdj] people are embracing a world where the augmented can express their identity in brand new ways.

But the leniency is only a facade, as enhanced surveillance algorithms within the implant are now monitoring every individual, detecting dissident thoughts the moment brain synapses connect.

texts.zh:
危难当前，唯有团结。每一个通过义体增强的[Species.GetAdj]都在为更美好的未来而奋斗，并相信身边的人也都会这样做。

具有钢铁般意志和光辉人格的[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]会带领我们的人民向前进，他们大可对此放心。
texts.en:
There is strength in numbers and its unifying momentum in the face of adversity. Every cyber-enhanced [Species.GetAdj] fights towards a better future together, trusting the person next to them to do the same.

Our people can rest secure in the knowledge that the radiant personality of their iron-willed [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName] guides them onwards.

texts.zh:
当人民继续在十字路口犹豫不决时时，我们的[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]必须抓住强化改造所提供的这一独特机会并作出决定。

应该让我们的人民保持一定的自由意志，以植入体进行监控，或是要让他们完全由领袖光芒四射的意志所引领。
texts.en:
As the people continue to waver in the crossroads, our [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName] must seize this unique opportunity offered by the augmentations and make a decision.

Should our people be allowed some personal freedoms while monitoring them through their implants, or have them influenced by the will of their leader's radiant personality?

label.zh: 给他们监视下的适度自由。
